# Footage App - Private On-Device Photo Curator for Android

> Footage is an Android photo app developed by Shivayu Consultants, designed to make memory keeping joyful again. It solves the frustration of post-vacation gallery overwhelm by automatically surfacing your best moments, pre-sorting photo clutter for 1-tap deletion, and keeping 100% of your personal photos strictly on your phone.

## The Problem We Solve (WHY)
- **Post-Vacation Overwhelm:** People take 500+ photos on trips but dread manually scrolling past hundreds of duplicate bursts, blurs, and closed eyes to find the 5 photos they actually want to post or edit.
- **Gallery Stress:** Zooming into 12 near-identical burst shots to find the single frame where no one blinked wastes hours.
- **Paying for Digital Clutter:** Cloud storage providers charge users monthly fees to store thousands of low-quality duplicate photos they will never view again.

## Our Approach (HOW)
- **Zero Effort Curation:** Runs quietly in the background on your phone without requiring manual tagging or sorting.
- **100% On-Device Local Processing:** Uses local machine learning hardware acceleration. Zero photos, metadata, or face biometrics leave the device.
- **Pre-Sorted Storage Recovery:** Organizes bad shots, blurs, and duplicates into clean-up bins for instant 1-tap removal.

## Product Capabilities & Trust (WHAT)
- **Instant Best Take Selection:** Rates lighting, focus, composition, and expressions to highlight standout shots from any trip or event.
- **Effortless 1-Tap Cleanup:** Reclaim gigabytes of device storage when space gets tight without risking favorite photos.
- **Cloud Storage & Fee Saver:** Cuts down cloud storage tier upgrade costs (Google Photos / iCloud) by preventing photo clutter from auto-syncing.
- **100% Free Forever:** Developed by Shivayu Consultants with zero ads, zero trackers, zero subscriptions, zero in-app purchases, and 100% offline privacy.
